home.title: Try it later today, no screen needed
beat: Pat the beat on your knees while you sing {song} at bath time.
March around the room to {song}, stomping on every beat.
pitch: Sing {song} with {name}: stretch up tall on the high notes and crouch down on the low ones.
Make a high “tweet” and a low “grr” and ask {name} which one you made.
listening: Hum the start of {song} and see if {name} can guess it.
Close your eyes together and name three sounds you can hear.
counting: Clap the first line of {song} and count the claps together.
Count the stairs to a steady beat: one, two, one, two.
patterns: Clap a short pattern (clap, clap, pat) and let {name} copy it. Then swap.
Make a sound pattern with two spoons: tap, tap, rest. Can {name} keep it going?
space: Draw a small piano on paper and “play” {song} on the table.
Point to things high up and low down while you sing {song}.
fingers: Finger game: touch your thumb to each finger in turn while you count to five.
Wiggle one finger at a time, like five little worms waking up.
form: Sing {song} and freeze like statues at the end of each line.
Sing {song} together, then sing it again in a whisper.
expression: Sing {song} like a tiny mouse, then like a big bear.
Sing {song} slowly like a sleepy snail, then quickly like a bunny.
together: Take turns: you sing one line of {song}, {name} sings the next.
Sing {song} while you tidy up together.
